question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Unfortunately**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank likely introduces a contrasting or negative aspect to the context provided.
 
• The term '**Unfortunately**' is used to express regret, disappointment, or sympathy over an unwelcome or unpleasant event. (दुर्भाग्यवश)
 
 
• **Example**: **Unfortunately**, the picnic had to be canceled due to rain.
 
 
 
• '**Unfortunately**', in this context, points towards a regrettable or negative situation that follows the context provided, making it the most suitable word to express a contrast or unfortunate circumstance. (दुर्भाग्यवश)
 
• Hence, the correct choice is **Unfortunately**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

 

Complete Passage: *Children are the future of any country and a country that does not take care of this valuable__ resource suffers later. A successful nation is that which makes its youth strong enough to lift this **__mighty__ responsibility on their shoulders. **__**Unfortunately**__**, this is not the case in our country. Education, which is a necessity, is still a (4) ________ here. Poor people (5) ________ to send their children to school.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Certainly **means without any doubt; surely, and is used to express firm conviction or agreement. (निश्चय ही)

 
 
• **Example**: She will **certainly **finish the project by the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Necessarily **implies something is inevitable or unavoidably required. It is used when something is logically or practically essential. (अनिवार्य रूप से)
 
 
• **Example**: Hard work is **necessarily **part of achieving success.
 
 
 
• **Partially **means to some extent; not completely, showing that something is only to a certain degree. (आंशिक रूप से)
 
 
• **Example**: The project was only **partially **successful in meeting its goals.
